clips.title: The story
paras: Senator Mehr Stonehallow of Ironforge has traveled directly to Gol'Bolar Quarry to address the sudden trogg invasion threatening Dun Morogh's mining operations. Seeking to reclaim the site, he enlists adventurers to cut down the aggressive Rockjaw Bonesnappers so miners can return to work.

It is rare to find a member of Ironforge's Senate standing in the slush and dirt of a contested mine, but Senator Mehr Stonehallow is no typical politician. Holding dual allegiance to the dwarven ruling body and the scholarly Explorers' League, Stonehallow has taken personal responsibility for organizing a response to the trogg infestation at Gol'Bolar Quarry. Rather than waiting for slow legislative measures, he directly contracts capable mercenaries and travelers to cull the invaders.

Gol'Bolar Quarry was once a vital source of stone and mineral wealth for Dun Morogh, but deep excavations broke into previously sealed subterranean hollows. Primitive, savage troggs of the Rockjaw tribe flooded into the pits, wrecking delicate mining equipment and driving out civilian laborers. Stonehallow's objective is to clear out the vicious Rockjaw Bonesnappers, paving the way for Mountaineer garrisons to secure the quarry and restore iron-shoveling infrastructure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.
If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If we can remove the troggs from Gol'Bolar quarry, it will be the first step of many that we will have to undertake to rid ourselves of this menace.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.
Thank you for your assistance, friend.
